title: SG-4.2.3 Enforce the tracked-dependency check in the test script
summary: Wire the tracked node_modules / test-cache check into npm test so it fails if such a path is tracked again
description: Context: game/frontend/src/lib/trackedNodeModules.ts has assertNoTrackedNodeModules but nothing runs it. Desired behavior: npm test fails whenever git tracks any node_modules or vitest cache path. Why: stops vendored Phaser and cache files from being committed again.
acceptance_criteria: Given a tracked path containing node_modules or a .vite cache directory, when the guard runs, then it throws naming that path
Given the frontend package.json, when npm test is read, then it runs the guard before vitest

preserve: existing trackedNodeModulesPaths, untrackNodeModules and assertNoTrackedNodeModules behavior

technical_constraints: Use vite-node already used by untrack:node-modules
definition_of_done: npm test runs the guard first and fails on tracked dependency or cache paths
